title: The School Girls
writer: Günther Hunold, Kurt Seelmann, Günther Heller
actors: Günther Kieslich, Wolf Harnisch, Helga Kruck
plot: Mockumentary about German schoolgirls openly talking about their scandalous sexual experiences. Some of these are illustrated through inserted vignettes. Also, a street reporter asks actual common folk about their views on sex.
